column2: How often have unexpected academic difficulties or changes in your study plans disrupted your routine?
column3: How often have you found the amount of academic work you needed to complete difficult to manage?
column4: How often have you struggled to complete assignments, projects, or other academic tasks within their deadlines?
column5: How often have examinations or academic assessments caused you concern about your academic performance?
column6: How often have concerns about placements, internships, employment, or your future career affected your academic life?
column7: How often have you had difficulty getting enough good-quality sleep because of your academic routine or related concerns?
column8: How often have you struggled to allocate enough time to your different academic responsibilities?
column9: How often have you felt that important academic responsibilities were beyond your control?
column10: How often have you felt that you lacked support from friends, family, classmates, or others when facing academic difficulties?
column11: How often have responsibilities outside your studies, such as family duties, employment, or commuting, interfered with your academic work?
column12: Considering your academic workload, assignments, examinations, deadlines, and other study-related responsibilities during the past two weeks, how would you rate your overall academic stress level?
